The '''Gamorrean cleaver''' was an unwieldy melee weapon created by the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] that was more likely to stun an enemy after the first blow, rather than killing outright. Nonetheless, the target of such a weapon did not have much of a chance of escaping. It could have also been used as an off-hand weapon by a skilled or strong fighter
